# Supersiffror från Nvidia: ”Extremt expansivt bolag”

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-08-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Guest fund manager Mats Wandrell (Alfred Berg) takes apart Nvidia's latest report. He calls it very strong: results beat on revenue and profit, guidance points to ~70% growth against the ~50% the market expected, and networking and the new Vera Rubin chip are both ramping. The one weak spot is gross margin, which is expected to dip to 72-73% before price hikes restore it. He will wait on adding to Nvidia, which is already about 5% of the fund, and sees suppliers such as Micron and TSMC as more attractive thanks to Nvidia's take-or-pay commitments and hyperscaler capex that is still rising. He also describes the fund's sentiment/momentum strategy, with Target as its largest bet, a tilt toward beaten-down software and more exposure to banks and energy.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest (Mats Wandrell, Alfred Berg) holds ~5% weight, will wait before acting further; expects decent return but doubts it will be the best AI stock.

#### Reasoning

Strong beat, ~70% guided growth, networking and Vera Rubin ramp, supplier commitments and rising hyperscaler capex support the case. Offsets: gross margin falling to 72-73% on memory costs, fund already heavy, guest doubts Nvidia will be the top AI-sector performer. Net: hold existing position, no adds.

#### Sell Triggers

- gross margin fails to recover toward 75% after price hikes
- hyperscaler capex growth slows sharply
- AI overcapacity forces price competition

> *"Ja, vi är rätt tunga. Nvidia har runt 5 procent i fonden. Kommer nog avvakta lite grann innan vi gör någonting ytterligare."*

---

### 🟢 MU — Micron | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest became more confident in Micron after Nvidia's comments on memory prices and take-or-pay style purchase commitments.

#### Reasoning

Nvidia is committing more capital to suppliers and guaranteeing volumes on near take-or-pay terms, securing Micron's deliveries. Elevated memory prices, which pressure Nvidia's margin, benefit Micron. Guest sees suppliers as more attractive than Nvidia itself right now.

#### Sell Triggers

- memory prices fall
- Nvidia reduces supplier commitments
- AI capex slowdown

> *"Däremot så finns det ju aktier kring, då jag blev mer konfident kring Micron."*

---

### 🟢 TSM — TSMC | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest says orders to TSMC will be enormous for the coming years; it makes and packages the chips and will definitely benefit.

#### Reasoning

As key foundry and packaging partner for Nvidia, TSMC captures growing AI chip demand and Nvidia's increased supplier commitments. Guest explicitly calls it a company that will definitely benefit over the next several years.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI chip demand slows
- hyperscaler capex cuts
- supply-chain disruption

> *"Beställningarna mot TSMC kommer ju vara enorma de närmaste åren. De gör ju både chippen och paketerar dem så att säga. Det är ett bolag som definitivt kommer gynnas."*

---

### 🟢 TGT — Target | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fund's largest bet; low-price retailer timely in inflationary US, in a turnaround phase.

#### Reasoning

Guest's sentiment/momentum strategy has made Target the biggest position, arguing low prices suit an inflation-heavy US consumer environment and the stock is in a turnaround. Guest stresses this is not concrete advice.

#### Sell Triggers

- turnaround stalls
- US inflation eases reducing trade-down benefit
- sentiment/momentum turns negative

> *"Till exempel vårt största bet i dag är ett amerikanskt låg discount store som heter Target"*

---
